scientific_integrity: The proof is an exact polynomial identity and discriminant classification. A standalone stdlib checker reproduces the exact rational identities; numerical stage trials are supporting tests only.
scientific_limitations: Not a failure claim for other weight directions, variable-step relaxation, orthogonal projection, other frequencies, or sufficiently small steps. No long-time stability theorem. Independent scientific priority verification has not been performed.
scientific_scope: One-step energy feasibility for the specified fixed-step RF-SSPRK(3,3) endpoint perturbation on a two-frequency four-real-dimensional skew system; complete open interval of initial energy fractions without any real correction.
title: A two-frequency obstruction to relaxation-free energy correction for SSPRK(3,3)
